baseline_models.focus_anchor: الأرض at word 1 is the patient of طحى at word 3 through the feminine suffix ها.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two roots compose a spatial operation: the lower member of a sky-ground relation is extended outward into an expanse.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the spatial patient and its below-ward orientation.
Spreading and extension supply the outward operation performed on that lower ground.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely names the earth and says that it was spread.
changed_reading.after: The oath isolates the making of an extended lower plane, defined relationally against what is above.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun can be fertile ground or a thick mat, while its governing verb can spread and press growth along a surface.
baseline_models.mechanism: Extension is functional rather than merely geometric: it lays out a soft, receptive substrate on which life can root, feed, and travel.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile ground supplies a living, growth-bearing quality to the object being spread.
The thick mat supplies a laid-out, habitable material analogy for the ground.
Spreading and widening turn the fertile material into an available surface.
Sprawling along and adhering to the ground supplies the close surface-contact by which vegetation or bodies occupy it.

changed_reading.before: The verb only enlarges inert terrain.
changed_reading.after: The act lays out a receptive, fertile mat whose extension enables rooting, dwelling, and use.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventories place ground-clinging, far-going, and circular motion around the same earth-spreading construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The earth functions as a reference field: bodies may rest against it, be carried far across it, or circle over it, so spreading organizes trajectories as well as area.

activation_trace.role: Sticking to the ground and lingering supply the fixed pole from which motion departs.
Extended going supplies long-range movement across the field.
Circling vultures supply a recurrent, non-linear trajectory around a grounded center.

changed_reading.before: Spreading denotes a static increase of surface area.
changed_reading.after: The spread earth is also a field that organizes rest, departure, distance, and return-like circulation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Marginal branches of both focus roots turn ground and spreading toward confrontation, mutual pushing, and large human formations.
baseline_models.mechanism: Making an expanse also makes an arena: collective bodies can assemble there, press against one another, and contest exposure or position.

activation_trace.role: Coming forward in confrontation converts ground from scenery into a site of encounter.
People pushing one another supplies the social force operating across the site.
A great multitude or broad army supplies collective scale to the spreading.

changed_reading.before: The earth is an empty physical extension.
changed_reading.after: Its extension can also be heard as making room for collective presence, pressure, and confrontation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb includes bodies sprawled against the ground after force and an isolated perishing branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: Spreading has a dangerous edge: the same low, extended profile can result from generative laying-out or from a body being pressed down and destroyed.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground supplies the terminal plane against which a body may be flattened.
A struck body or animal sprawling against the ground supplies the violent route to flat extension.
The isolated perishing sense keeps destruction live at the far edge of the verb.

changed_reading.before: Spreading is exclusively a benign creative act.
changed_reading.after: The creative expanse carries a latent reversible image of being leveled down to the ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the earth appears, exposure, following, uncovering, and covering establish a recurring visibility cycle. The spread surface becomes the field on which those temporal changes can register.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground supplies the visible field affected by changing light.
Circular motion supplies a recurrent rather than merely linear mode of traversal.
Emergence into sunlight supplies the phase in which the field becomes exposed.
Following and succession supply temporal ordering between phases.
Uncovering and manifestation make visibility an active operation upon the field.
A covering laid over something supplies the inverse phase that veils the field.

structural_cues: Ayat 91:1-4 proceed from radiance through following and disclosure to covering, immediately before the paired sky and earth constructions.
Repeated feminine object suffixes make a formally continuous field even though their local antecedents remain debatable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cyclic light, following, disclosure, covering, and a circular focus branch; I infer that the spread earth receives these operations as their display field. A live alternative is that the cycle concerns only the luminaries and does not modify طحى.

changed_reading.before: The spread earth is a timeless static plane.
changed_reading.after: It is a temporally modulated visibility field, repeatedly exposed, traversed, disclosed, and veiled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent sky-building line turns the earth's extension into the complementary lower operation of one constructed whole: assembly and support above, laid-out availability below.

activation_trace.role: Ground opposite the sky supplies the lower architectural member.
Spreading supplies the floor-like operation complementary to building.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper member of the paired structure.
Joining parts into a building supplies deliberate assembly rather than accidental extension.
Ribs or supports on which something rests supply a load-bearing analogy for the ordered whole.

structural_cues: 91:5 and 91:6 are adjacent syntactic twins: a cosmic noun followed by وما, a perfect verb, and ها.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an upper overshadowing member, assembly, supports, lower ground, and extension; I infer a coordinated architecture in which spreading functions as floor-making. The alternative is two independent oath images linked only by rhetoric.

changed_reading.before: The earth is flattened in isolation.
changed_reading.after: Its spreading is the lower, load-bearing counterpart to the sky's construction within a coordinated cosmic architecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next syntactic twin shifts from earth to self and from spreading to making even and complete. Its branch inventory unexpectedly returns to wide smooth land, causing physical extension and inward proportioning to cross-interpret one another.

activation_trace.role: Spreading and widening supply the earth-side shaping operation.
The very self or identity of a thing supplies the inward whole being shaped.
Straightness and intrinsic completion supply proportion and integrity, not mere flatness.
A just middle supplies balance and measured placement within the formed whole.
Wide smooth ground directly loops the soul-forming root back into the earth's spatial profile.

structural_cues: 91:6 and 91:7 repeat the sequence و + noun + وما + perfect verb + ها across earth and self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact syntactic parallelism, completion, balance, selfhood, and a land branch inside سوى; I infer that طحى can be heard as proportioning the earth into a fit whole. The live alternative is that the formal parallel does not license cross-domain semantics.

changed_reading.after: It names a mode of earth-forming in which extension, smoothness, balance, and fitness belong to one proportioning act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wide splitting, the ploughman's cleavage of earth, and growth form a material sequence: opening the laid-out substrate makes its latent fertility productive.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile ground supplies the latent capacity for cultivation.
Spreading makes the fertile substrate broadly available for subsequent operations.
Wide fissuring and eruption supply the first opening of the substrate.
The ploughman who cleaves earth converts opening into deliberate cultivation.
Growth and increase supply the productive result of working the opened ground.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from the soul's two capacities in 91:8 to success through purification in 91:9, while the cited branches render that transition as opening, ploughing, and growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile earth, spreading, fissure, ploughing, and growth; I infer a causal cultivation chain from laid-out capacity to productive increase. The alternative is that the agricultural images only metaphorize the soul and should not feed back into 91:6.

changed_reading.before: The spread earth is finished once its dimensions are extended.
changed_reading.after: Spreading prepares a cultivable substrate whose completion remains potential until it is opened, worked, and made to grow.

context_deltas.mechanism: Growth and covert insertion establish opposite relations to the same receptive surface: one brings capacity upward into increase, while the other presses it out of sight.

activation_trace.role: Fertile ground supplies a substrate capable of either supporting or covering life.
Close adherence and flattening against the surface supply the pressure by which something can be kept down.
Growth and increase supply the upward, manifest outcome.
Secret insertion and concealment supply the inverse operation of burying capacity beneath view.

structural_cues: 91:9 and 91:10 form an explicit success-failure antithesis with matching من + verb + ها constructions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile ground, growth, concealment, and surface adherence; I infer opposed cultivation and burial operations on one substrate. The alternative is that زكى and دسى remain wholly intrapsychic and do not alter the earth image.

changed_reading.before: A fertile spread automatically tends toward life.
changed_reading.after: The same receptive expanse is morally ambivalent: it can bring capacity into growth or become the cover under which capacity is suppressed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two mapped inventories converge on water crossing its limit. Against that surge, the focus act reads less as limitless expansion than as extension held within a proportioned field.

activation_trace.role: Spreading and widening supply extension whose proper measure is being tested.
A just middle supplies the contextual idea of measured placement.
Rising water and sweeping force supply the dominant image of extension escaping its boundary.
The second mapped root independently preserves overflowing water, strengthening the excess-versus-measure contrast.

structural_cues: 91:11 turns from paired individual outcomes to a community characterized by طغواها, beginning the narrative of collective breach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies widening, balance, and two overflow images; I infer that ordered spreading has an implicit boundary and that transgression is expansion without measure. The alternative is that طغيان is purely moral and supplies no spatial contrast.

changed_reading.before: More extension is simply more of the creative act.
changed_reading.after: The earth's spreading is measured extensibility; force that outruns measure becomes the destructive counter-image of overflow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The stirring of what was still and the dispatch of a group activate the focus branches of far-going, crowd scale, and mutual pushing. The expanse becomes a launchable field for consequential action.

activation_trace.role: Ground as a place of confrontation supplies the social site into which action emerges.
Mutual pushing supplies the force generated when agents occupy the field together.
A multitude or broad army supplies the collective scale of the field.
Stirring the stationary from rest supplies the transition from latent presence to action.
A group's forceful setting-out supplies directed collective movement across the arena.

structural_cues: After the community's transgression in 91:11, 91:12 narrows to the moment one agent surges into action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confrontation, crowd pressure, awakening from rest, and group movement; I infer that the spread ground functions as the enabling field that converts latent agency into outward action. The alternative is that انبعث marks only one actor and leaves the earth image untouched.

changed_reading.before: The earth is passive room occupied after creation.
changed_reading.after: Its spread is an enabling social field on which stillness can become directed movement, crowd pressure, and irreversible action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gentle conveyance, animal management, and a defined share or channel of water transform fertile expanse into a governed common. Physical room entails access, pacing, and restraint.

activation_trace.role: Fertile ground supplies the shared resource-bearing territory.
Spreading supplies the extent across which access must be organized.
Gentleness and deliberation supply the regulated manner appropriate to sharing the field.
Taming and management supply the human-animal relation operating within the common.
A water share and its channel supply concrete allocation across the land.

structural_cues: The messenger's warning culminates in the compact protected pair ناقة الله وسقياها, placing an animal and her water access together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile extent, deliberate conduct, managed animal life, and an allotted water channel; I infer that spreading creates a common whose use carries obligations. The alternative is that the allocation belongs only to the specific narrative and does not generalize back to earth-making.

changed_reading.before: The spread earth is undifferentiated space available without conditions.
changed_reading.after: It is a resource-bearing common whose extension creates shares, channels, routes, and duties of restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The narrative performs the dark edge already latent in the focus branches: lower limbs are cut, a body is brought to ground, annihilation spreads over the group, and equalization closes the sequence.

activation_trace.role: Ground together with an animal's lower legs and hoof-side supplies the bodily interface later attacked.
A struck body sprawling against the earth supplies the posture produced by the attack.
Perishing supplies the terminal edge that the later annihilation makes active.
Cutting an animal's legs supplies the concrete loss of upright support.
Total eradication scales the fallen-body image from one victim to the community.
Equalization supplies the final leveling operation and reverses constructive proportion into undifferentiated outcome.

structural_cues: The rapid chain of prefixed ف verbs in 91:14 ends with فسواها, reusing ها after injury and eradication.
The same سوى root that forms the self in 91:7 closes the destruction scene in 91:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ground-facing limbs, violent sprawling, perishing, hamstringing, eradication, and equalization; I infer a deliberate reversal from life-supporting spread to punitive leveling. The alternative is that the destructive focus branches are accidental lexical margins and فسواها refers only to the destroyed settlement or people.

changed_reading.before: The earth's spreading is a one-way image of constructive creation.
changed_reading.after: Constructive laying-out and catastrophic leveling become reversible profiles: what is made fit and extended can also be brought uniformly down.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heel, trace, sequel, and remainder resist reading the final leveling as pure erasure. The extended ground becomes a medium on which an act continues as aftermath.

activation_trace.role: The ground supplies the surface on which tracks and remnants can persist.
Extension supplies the spatial and temporal reach over which aftermath can continue.
Heel and footprint supply the material image of an act leaving a track.
The end or consequence supplies temporal continuation beyond the act.
Remainder and trace keep a residue live after apparent leveling.

structural_cues: The final ayah immediately follows eradication and equalization but names an عقب, forcing attention from the act to what follows it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ground, extension, footprint, consequence, and remainder; I infer that the spread surface bears aftermath rather than merely receiving a finished event. The alternative is that عقب is wholly abstract and leaves no trace-bearing image in 91:6.

changed_reading.before: Leveling closes the field by erasing all differentiation.
changed_reading.after: Even leveled ground can carry the reach, track, and remainder of what occurred upon it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant و س م mapping carried under the context root س م و rather than the ordinary sky branch. It remains anchored because that branch explicitly depicts first rain marking earth with vegetation, while the focus supplies fertile ground and spreading. Render it as a split-root activation or material analogy, not as a claim that السماء lexically means rain-marking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fertile earth at word 1 and its spreading at word 3 can form a receptive sheet on which marks become growth.

activation_trace.role: Fertile ground supplies the receptive material that can answer rain with vegetation.
Spreading supplies the broad sheet over which the mark can appear.
First rain marking earth with plants supplies the sky-to-ground inscription event.

changed_reading.before: The earth is a neutral sheet stretched beneath the sky.
changed_reading.after: It is a receptive sheet that sky-borne rain can inscribe into visible vegetation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The circling image comes from vultures around a fallen body, so transferring it into the sun-moon sequence is branch-distant and affectively dark. It remains anchored in the focus verb's own B003 and is activated by lunar following. Render it only as a kinetic circumferential echo, not as a lexical assertion that طحى means orbit or as a scientific cosmology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: طحى at word 3 contains a circular-motion branch that can complicate its dominant linear extension.

activation_trace.role: Ground supplies the center or lower reference around which recurrent motion is perceived.
Vultures circling supply the focus verb's own circumferential trajectory.
The moon and its sky-light supply the moving celestial participant.
Following and succession supply recurrence and ordered pursuit.

changed_reading.before: Spreading is only a straight radial movement from center to edge.
changed_reading.after: A faint coexisting image treats expanse as organized by repeated following and circulation around a grounded reference.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because its downstream channel image is activated through the branch inventory of ذنب in the phrase about sin. It remains materially coherent: the packet also supplies a river cleaving earth, an allotted irrigation channel, abundant water, fertile ground, and extension. Render it as an ecological network activation, never as the lexical translation of ذنب in 91:14.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fertile earth at word 1 and spreading at word 3 can anchor a distributed water-bearing terrain.

activation_trace.role: Fertile ground supplies the terrain whose productivity depends on distributed water.
Spreading and extension supply the area across which the network runs.
A flowing river cleaving earth supplies the upstream incision of the terrain.
A share of irrigation and its channel supply controlled distribution.
Abundant water supplies the volume that the terrain must receive and route.
Watercourses and the tails of valleys supply downstream endings and distributary reach.

changed_reading.before: The spread earth is a continuous dry plane.
changed_reading.after: It can be imagined as a catchment laid out from river incision through allotted channels to the tails of valleys.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This model is cross-domain because it joins termite-eaten wood and a festering wound to hidden insertion and communal eradication. It remains anchored in two branches of the focus noun and in the contrast between visible extent and concealed corruption. Render it as a fragility analogy only, not as a claim that the earth itself is diseased in the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الأرض at word 1 includes small-scale hidden corrosion and festering, while طحى at word 3 supplies the wide visible extent that can conceal them.

activation_trace.role: A termite silently eating wood supplies hidden structural hollowing beneath an intact appearance.
A wound festering with pus supplies corruption that grows beneath a surface.
Great breadth and mass supply the large visible whole vulnerable to local hidden decay.
Covert insertion supplies concealment as the mechanism by which damage escapes notice.
Eradication supplies the eventual whole-system collapse at the end of hidden deterioration.

changed_reading.before: Vast extension implies a stable and fully visible foundation.
changed_reading.after: A wide surface can conceal tiny local corruption that hollows the whole until collapse becomes sudden and total.

strongest_changes: The adjacent sky-building and soul-proportioning constructions recast spreading as one deliberate shaping operation within an ordered whole.
Fissure, ploughing, growth, and watering turn the expanse from inert geometry into a cultivable and apportioned common.
Hamstringing, eradication, and equalization activate the focus verb's violent edge, reversing constructive spreading into leveling-to-ground.
The final cluster of heel, consequence, and remainder prevents that leveling from becoming pure erasure by making earth an aftermath-bearing surface.
summary.what_was_special: The same two-word focus held several live mechanisms without requiring a final choice: cosmic floor, fertile mat, temporal display, social arena, bounded common, and reversible leveling. Especially productive were the direct land branch inside سوى, the body-ground interface linking أرض to the hamstrung camel, and non-dominant split mappings that opened rain-inscription and overflow readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ما foregrounds an agent, an act, or a broader productive principle materially changes how strongly the architectural model reads.
The destructive طحى branches may be genuinely activated by 91:14 or may remain distant lexical shadows intensified by narrative proximity.
The rain-inscription, circular-motion, hydrological, and concealed-decay readings are coherent activations but should not be promoted into direct lexical translations.
The feminine suffix chain creates strong formal continuity, but its local antecedents and the degree of cross-ayah semantic transfer remain open.
